findings.rationale: The docstring says the payout is the gross amount less the platform fee, but the code adds the fee (`gross + fee`). Every merchant would be overpaid by twice the fee. Change it to `gross - fee`.

This new money-handling function has no tests. A simple test asserting payout(gross) == gross - platform_fee(gross) would have caught the sign error. Add unit tests, including zero and boundary amounts.
